note: What a server sends to put another spell into a slot of a unit's that already holds one. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot. A champion's own spells count from 0.

bits.name: summonerSlots
bits.note: Set where the slot counts among the summoner slots, so that 0 and 1 name those two.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the client loads the spell under, ended by a zero byte. A client shows the named spell's icon in the slot, and treats a name it has no spell for as an error.
